battle.name: 克里特戰爭
battle.brief: 公元前205年，埃及托勒密三世指羅得海軍劫掠克里特，率六十艘戰船渡海入克里特，掃平島內並圍困林多斯城；前201年羅得海軍於以弗所外海擊潰埃及艦隊解圍。卡面的埃及月牙劍是前1500年前後的青銅古物，此役僅為王朝儀仗，前線實用 machaira 彎刀、長矛與僱傭射手。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 克里特戰爭是公元前205年至前200年埃及托勒密王朝與以羅得島為核心的海上聯盟之間的一場海陸兼用戰爭，交戰重心在克里特島、羅得島本身與基克拉澤斯諸島。埃及一方由國王托勒密三世尤厄革忒斯直接統帥，出征軍以王室的常備步兵、弓箭手和大量希臘傭兵為骨幹，輔以在亞歷山大里亞與地中海沿岸港口徵集的三列、四列槳戰船，艦隊指揮多由王室任命的希臘將領擔任。羅得一方並非單一城邦，而是有議事會與十一人執政團的海上聯盟：海軍由城邦直接出資維持，艦隊司令常外聘希臘人，前201年擊敗埃及艦隊的阿伽托斯特拉圖斯即是出身克尼杜斯的職業指揮官。羅得的盟邦包括埃亞同盟、帕加馬王國、拜占庭與基茲庫斯。克里特島上的各城在戰前已因階級衝突與羅得的干預而裂成兩派，多座城市的流亡寡頭公開站到埃及一方，島上原有的克里特同盟因此名存實亡，克里特實際上成了埃及與羅得各自下注的棋盤。
countriesEn: The Cretan War was a combined land and sea war fought between the Ptolemaic kingdom of Egypt and a maritime league centred on the island of Rhodes between 205 and 200 BC, with the fighting concentrated on Crete, on Rhodes itself and in the Cyclades. The Egyptian side was commanded in person by King Ptolemy III Euergetes. His expeditionary army was built on the native infantry and archers of the crown together with a large body of Greek mercenaries, and was supported by triremes and quadriremes mustered at Alexandria and along the Mediterranean seaboard, the fleet usually placed under Greek officers appointed by the court. The Rhodian side was not a single polis but a maritime league with an assembly and a board of eleven executives at its head: the navy was financed and crewed by the city itself, and admirals were commonly hired from outside, the most famous of them being Agathostratus of Cnidus, the professional commander who destroyed the Egyptian fleet in 201 BC. Rhodes's partners included the Achaean League, the kingdom of Pergamon, Byzantium and Cyzicus. On Crete the cities had already split into two camps before the war began, because of class conflict and Rhodes's interference; in a number of towns the exiled oligarchs openly sided with Egypt, the old Cretan league existed in name only, and Crete had become in effect a board on which Egypt and Rhodes each placed their stakes.
people: 托勒密三世於前246年即位，前205年先後清除宮中反對勢力，其中包括他的母親貝勒尼基二世——她在宮中遇害，一般認為出自國王授意——隨即把克里特遠征當作重建軍威與王朝正當性的手段。Polybius 記他在出戰前集結大批兵力、銀兩與糧秣，並特別指出羅得人造船與航海經驗老到，卻在克里特內陸缺乏可靠的盟友。羅得方面最關鍵的人物是海軍指揮官阿伽托斯特拉圖斯，他率領由羅得、埃亞同盟、帕加馬、拜占庭與基茲庫斯船隻拼成的聯合艦隊，於以弗所外海選戰，利用接舷戰與分進合擊，逐段吃掉托勒密的先頭船團，奪下其旗艦。Polybius 本人當時在羅馬，說明他是以羅得方面的檔案與當事人的口述核對戰況，因此今日對此戰的細節描述多以他的《歷史》第三卷為骨幹。克里特方面，各城守軍與民團的領袖，以及為埃及效命的克里特弓手、投石手首領同樣左右戰局，傭兵與盟邦指揮官的完整名單至今仍缺。
peopleEn: Ptolemy III Euergetes took the throne in 246 BC. In 205 BC he first eliminated opposition inside his own court, among them his mother Berenice II, who was killed in the palace and whose death is generally attributed to the king's own orders; he then used the expedition to Crete as a means of rebuilding his military prestige and the legitimacy of his rule. Polybius records that he concentrated great numbers of men, silver and provisions before sailing out, and he notes in particular that the Rhodians were skilled shipwrights and experienced seamen, yet had no reliable allies in the interior of Crete. The decisive figure on the Rhodian side was the admiral Agathostratus, who led the combined fleet pieced together from Rhodes, the Achaean League, Pergamon, Byzantium and Cyzicus, chose his battle off Ephesus, and used boarding action and successive concentrations of strength to destroy the Egyptian vanguard detachments one by one and to capture the flagship. Polybius himself adds a great deal: he was in Rome at the time and states that he checked the course of the war against Rhodian records and the testimony of participants, so that the reconstruction of the fighting that survives today rests largely on the third book of his Histories. On the Cretan side the commanders of the city garrisons and of the local levies, together with the leaders of the Cretan archers and slingers in Egyptian service, shaped the course of the battle as well, although the full list of mercenary and allied commanders is still missing.
kits: 卡面的埃及月牙劍（khopesh）是公元前1500年前後第二中間期已在埃及普及的青銅外彎單刃短劍，外弧的刃形使斬擊之後不必扭轉手腕拔出，握柄常纏亞麻纏帶，柄首或作雙鳥首形。它在此役的位置是古物而非現役武器：前205年的埃及前線士兵早已改用 machaira 一類的彎刀，配以 sarissa 型長槍與短刃，鎧甲多為分段式或鱗狀，胸甲與頸甲齊備；海軍士兵在甲板上同樣用彎刀、槍與投石索作近身戰。真正延續月牙劍傳統的，是克里特與羅得一方的近身曲刃：克里特弓手與重裝步兵慣用雙面直刃短劍與尖頭刺槍，羅得水手則用包銅撞角、繩梯與陶罐裝的燃燒油攻擊敵艦。月牙劍本身在前205年已歸入祭祀與王權象徵，見於托勒密王朝的宮廷器用與神廟奉獻，軍中偶有攜帶以示古法戰功，但並未列入裝備。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on the card is a bronze single-edged sword with an outward-curving blade, already in general Egyptian use around 1500 BC in the Second Intermediate Period. Because the edge curves away from the line of the arm, a stroke does not have to be twisted free of the target; the grip was usually wrapped with linen, and the pommel was sometimes shaped as a pair of birds' heads. Its role in this campaign was that of an antique rather than a service weapon. By 205 BC the Egyptian infantry in the field had long moved on to the machaira, a curved sword, used together with the long sarissa-type spear and short blades, while their armour consisted of plated or scale corselets with chest and neck guards; marines on the decks of the warships carried the same curved swords, spears and slings for close work. The curved single edge that really carried on from the khopesh line lay with the Cretans and Rhodians in close combat: Cretan archers and heavy infantry normally carried straight double-edged swords and spear-points, while Rhodian crews worked with bronze-sheathed rams, boarding ladders and jars of burning oil against enemy hulls. By 205 BC the khopesh itself had passed into sacrifice and royal symbolism, appearing in Ptolemaic court treasure and temple dedications, and it was occasionally carried in the army as a token of ancient martial honour, but it was not on the equipment list.
tactics: 戰術層面上，埃及與羅得代表兩種相反的海戰思路。托勒密選擇先取陸權：遠征軍登陸克里特後掃清島內鄉村、迫各城歸附，再集中主力圍困羅得島的林多斯城，企圖以圍城逼羅得屈服；但遠征軍遠離亞歷山大里亞後全靠海運維持，糧秣與援兵一旦被切斷，圍城便變成自困。羅得則避免在開闊海域與埃及艦隊硬碰，改以港口、島嶼與近岸游擊消耗對手，把主力佈在克里特與本土之間的航線上。前201年轉折點在以弗所外海的接舷戰：阿伽托斯特拉圖斯把艦隊佈成縱隊，選上風與有利潮位，逐段咬住埃及先頭船團，配合登板與投射火器覆蓋，把分遣隊與主力之間的協同切斷，再集中攻擊旗艦。艦隊戰之後，埃及轉而圖謀奪取基克拉澤斯諸島以威脅羅得航線，羅得海軍以小隊巡邏與夜襲反覆奪回，雙方在島嶼補給點的反覆拉鋸一直延續到和約。
tacticsEn: At the tactical level the war pitted two opposite ways of fighting at sea. Ptolemy chose to take the land first: after landing on Crete his expedition swept the rural districts, forced the cities into submission, and then concentrated the main force in a siege of Lindos on Rhodes, hoping that the investment of the island's capital would break Rhodian resistance. But once the expedition stood far from Alexandria it lived entirely on sea transport, and if grain and reinforcements were cut off the siege turned into a self-blockade. Rhodes, for its part, avoided meeting the Egyptian fleet in open water, harried it from harbours, islands and coastal waters instead, and kept the main strength on the sea lanes between Crete and the homeland. The turning point came in the boarding fight off Ephesus in 201 BC: Agathostratus formed the fleet in line, took the weather gauge and the advantage of the current, and took the Egyptian vanguard piece by piece, using boarding and covering fire to sever the coordination between the detachments and the main body, and only then concentrated on the flagship. After the action at sea Egypt turned to seizing the Cyclades in order to threaten the Rhodian sea lanes, and the Rhodian navy recovered the islands again and again with patrols and night attacks, so that the tug-of-war over the island supply-points ran on until the settlement.
data: 時間與數字方面，Polybius 留下的紀錄最為完整：戰爭始於前205年，約於前201至前200年間以和約收束，歷時約五至六年；林多斯之圍自前205年打到前201年，約四年。埃及方面的出征規模，Polybius 記為六十艘戰船，以三列與四列槳船為主，步兵九千、騎兵兩千，並備有大量銀兩與糧秣；羅得方面的核心艦隊約四十艘，另有埃亞同盟、帕加馬、拜占庭與基茲庫斯的船隻與援兵。以希臘式三列槳船計，一艘船的划槳手即有一百七十人上下，四列槳船更多，故實際在冊人數遠高於常見的「數萬大軍」一類說法。克里特島上有二十餘座獨立的城邦要塞，各城守軍多則數百、少則數十。就航程而言，以弗所外海距林多斯直線不足二百五十公里，但實際航線須繞行海峽與沿岸，需三至七日。
dataEn: On dates and numbers the fullest record is Polybius's. The war began in 205 BC and was closed by a settlement in about 201 to 200 BC, lasting roughly five to six years; the siege of Lindos ran from 205 to 201 BC, about four years in all. For the Egyptian expedition Polybius gives sixty warships, chiefly triremes and quadriremes, nine thousand foot and two thousand horse, together with a large stock of silver and provisions. The core Rhodian fleet was on the order of forty ships, with further vessels and contingents supplied by the Achaean League, Pergamon, Byzantium and Cyzicus. A Greek trireme carried about one hundred and seventy oarsmen and a quadrireme rather more, so the real number of men under arms stood far above the usual vague talk of tens of thousands. Crete held a little over twenty independent city fortresses, whose garrisons numbered in the hundreds or, in some cases, only a few dozen. In terms of distance, the waters off Ephesus lie less than two hundred and fifty kilometres from Lindos in a straight line, but the sea route had to be worked around the straits and along the coast, taking between three and seven days.
cause: 直接起因是羅得海軍的擴張與托勒密三世的索賠。克里特與基克拉澤斯是羅得的傳統海上腹地，羅得自前四世紀起以商船隊、掠奪與航稅維持島邦經濟，軍力愈強，沿海城邦的抱怨愈多；前205年托勒密三世指羅得襲擾克里特航運，要求解散海軍並歸還基克拉澤斯諸島，羅得拒絕，克里特島上的流亡寡頭與反對派隨即邀請埃及出兵。背景是托勒密王朝內部的危機：前205年他的母親貝勒尼基二世在宮中遇害，宮廷清洗尚未結束，王位與繼承權仍受內廷掣肘，遠征克里特既是奪取軍功與正當性的手段，也可一舉把視線移出亞歷山大里亞。深層原因還有東地中海秩序的重排：羅得自視為海上強權並有埃亞同盟、帕加馬作後盾，埃托利亞聯盟與安提柯王朝在東方的角力，都把克里特與基克拉澤斯推到最前線。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the expansion of the Rhodian navy and the claims Ptolemy III put forward against it. Crete and the Cyclades were Rhodes's traditional maritime hinterland; from the fourth century BC the island had lived on its merchant fleet, on depredation and on harbour dues, and the stronger its navy grew, the more the coastal cities complained. In 205 BC Ptolemy III accused Rhodes of harrying Cretan shipping, demanded that it disband its fleet and give up the Cyclades, and Rhodes refused; the exiled oligarchs and the opposition in several Cretan cities promptly called on Egypt to intervene. Behind this lay a crisis inside the Ptolemaic dynasty: in 205 BC Berenice II was killed in the palace, the purge of the court was not yet finished, and the succession and the legitimacy of the king were still at the mercy of the household, so that the expedition to Crete was both a way of gaining military credit and of moving attention away from Alexandria. The deeper cause was the reordering of the eastern Mediterranean. Rhodes regarded itself as a sea power backed by the Achaean League and Pergamon, and the rivalry of the Aetolian League and the Antigonid kings pushed Crete and the Cyclades to the front line of the struggle.
impact: 此役的長遠影響，遠大於克里特島本身的得失。和約之後，羅得守住基克拉澤斯、海上聯盟的地位鞏固，其海軍成為東地中海最具經驗的武力；前200年前後，羅馬、迦太基、埃托利亞聯盟與帕加馬組成對付馬其頓王菲利普五世的同盟，羅得以海軍與基地居中樞紐，隨即捲入對菲利普的戰爭，幾乎牽動整個東地中海的海上格局。埃及方面，托勒密三世雖未得手，卻保住了王朝與地中海東部的存在，並在戰後重建海軍，補回前一年宮廷內亂造成的損失。仲裁制度方面，羅馬與迦太基共同主持和約，讓遠方城邦的爭端交由第三方裁決，這種做法在希臘化世界留下深遠痕跡。克里特各城獲得自由後立刻互相攻伐，島上同盟崩解、前201年後陷入城邦混戰，幾十年後全島落入羅馬統治，這條長期走向由本役的結果決定。最後，在兵器史上，從月牙劍到 machaira 與 kopis 的曲刃傳統也在本役的分界線上被重新標示：前205年之後，埃及與希臘世界真正普及的是長矛與短柄彎刀。
impactEn: The long-term consequences of this war were far greater than the fate of Crete itself. After the settlement Rhodes kept the Cyclades, its position within the maritime league was consolidated, and its navy became the most experienced fighting force in the eastern Mediterranean. Around 200 BC Rome, Carthage, the Aetolian League and Pergamon formed a coalition against the Macedonian king Philip V, and Rhodes stood at the hub of it as the sea power and the base of supply, soon to be drawn into the war against Philip, which reshaped the naval balance of the whole eastern Mediterranean. Egypt, though it gained nothing of what it wanted in Crete, kept the dynasty and its presence in the eastern Mediterranean, and rebuilt its fleet after the damage done by the civil disturbances of the preceding year. In the practice of arbitration, the fact that Rome and Carthage together acted as arbiters, and that a quarrel between distant cities was handed over to third parties for decision, left a deep mark on the Hellenistic world. In Crete itself the cities, once freed, immediately turned on one another; the island league collapsed, Crete fell into a period of city-state anarchy after 201 BC, and the whole island was eventually absorbed by Rome, a course whose direction was fixed by the outcome of this war. Finally, in the history of weapons, the line between the khopesh and the curved machaira and kopis was re-marked here: after 205 BC what spread through Egypt and the Greek world was not the sickle sword but the long spear and the short curved blade.
result: 前201至前200年間，羅得一方在埃亞同盟、帕加馬、拜占庭與基茲庫斯支援下，經仲裁者羅馬、迦太基與埃托利亞聯盟居中調停，與托勒密三世達成和約：克里特各城恢復自由，不歸埃及亦不歸羅得；原屬羅得的基克拉澤斯諸島仍歸羅得；托勒密取回大部分被俘船艦與船員，兵員與財貨按協議清償；被羅得繳獲的埃及旗艦已奉獻於雅典娜女神神廟，留在羅得作戰利品，沒有歸還。就戰役本身而言，埃及的克里特目標完全落空，遠征軍退回埃及，克里特各城卻因獲得自由而陷入新的混戰；羅得保住了海軍實力、基克拉澤斯與東地中海的制海地位，並在隨後對菲利普五世的戰爭中成為聯盟的海軍支柱。托勒密王朝的海上聲威重挫，此後數十年都未能再與羅得爭雄東地中海。
resultEn: Between 201 and 200 BC, with the Achaean League, Pergamon, Byzantium and Cyzicus behind Rhodes and with the arbiters, Rome, Carthage and the Aetolian League, mediating, a settlement was reached with Ptolemy III. The Cretan cities were restored to freedom, belonging neither to Egypt nor to Rhodes; the Cyclades, which had been Rhodes's before the war, remained Rhodes's; Ptolemy recovered the greater part of his captured ships and their crews, and men and money were accounted for under the terms; the Egyptian flagship that the Rhodians had taken had already been dedicated in the temple of Athena and remained at Rhodes as a trophy, never given back. In the war itself the Egyptian aim in Crete failed completely and the expedition withdrew to Egypt, while the Cretan city-states, now free, fell into fresh quarrels among themselves. Rhodes kept its fleet, the Cyclades and its command of the eastern Mediterranean, and was to become the naval pillar of the coalition in the war against Philip V that followed. The maritime reputation of the Ptolemaic dynasty was badly shaken, and for decades to come it did not rival Rhodes in the eastern Mediterranean.
